caseName: Federal Trade Commission v. Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co.
caseNameFull: Federal Trade Commission v. Goodyear Tire & Rubber Co.
attorneys: Solicitor General Jackson and Mr. W. T. Kelley for petitioner. Mr. Grover Higgins for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Stone and Mr. Justice Reed took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
